title: Capture bounded secret-safe Engram control stderr for EOF diagnostics
outcome: The owned Engram control child's stderr is drained and retained in bounded form, with secret-safe evidence surfaced when its stdout reaches EOF, without changing control protocol, retry, deadline, authority or cleanup decisions.
acceptance: Owned control children continuously drain stderr with a fixed memory bound and bounded secret-safe diagnostic evidence; raw credentials, request/reply payloads and private paths are not exposed.

On control startup or request EOF, diagnostics correlate the captured stderr evidence with the existing exact-child PID and observed exit state without delaying EOF reporting or changing protocol, deadlines, retries, authority or cleanup ownership.

Controlled actual-child tests cover startup and request EOF with a live child on Unix, and bounded noisy stderr and secret exclusion after normal child exit on Windows. Windows live-child EOF is outside this item's acceptance, with the observed limitation retained in test-96c9911f-b05f-41d8-bd76-d59fee1827dd and test-838a015b-ab4f-4cca-930d-52be0b18f6fd. Focused compile/tests including the required persistence guard, a fresh review pair with no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the normal integration gate cover the exact candidate.

completion.summary: Delivered bounded secret-safe control stderr evidence on existing exact-child failure diagnostics, including caller-side timeout/disconnect snapshots before cleanup. Landed as combo30 d6a359fc with fresh composite pair and qualifying same-tree Windows B FULL.
